box-from-sheet.alt: Left: a 12-inch square sheet with a square of side x at each corner and dashed fold lines; folding gives an open box of height x and base 12 - 2x by 12 - 2x. Right: the graph of V(x) = x(12 - 2x) squared for 0 ≤ x ≤ 6, zero at both ends, highest at (2, 128).

box-sheet-16x10.alt: A sheet 16 inches wide and 10 inches tall with a square of side x cut from each corner; the sides fold up along dashed lines into an open box of height x and base 16 - 2x by 10 - 2x inches.
